newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Cyclicals bump Swedish shares to higher close.
newsitem.headline: Cyclicals bump Swedish shares to higher close.

text.p: Gains in cyclical shares and telecoms group Ericsson nudged the Stockholm bourse to a higher close on Tuesday.
The bourse general index closed up 0.88 percent at 1,985.74 after turnover of 3.0 billion crowns.
A strong undertone indicated more gains were possible, brokers said.
"In the short term we will probably see a continuation of the upward trend," one broker said. Ericsson closed up 3.50 crowns to 157, whilst the forestry sector index jumped 2.39 percent.

SCA rose 5.50 crowns to 147.50. AssiDoman, which gained 3.50 crowns to 167, posted a 1.23 billion crown profit after financial net for the first six months compared to 2.38 billion in the same 1995 period.
Handelsbanken's share fell two crowns to 140. The bank posted a profit of 3.00 billion crowns after loan losses for the first half of the year, 17 percent up on its profit in the same 1995 period.
Mortgage institute Stadshypotek rose four crowns to 168.50 on buy-out rumours. Handelsbanken said it did not rule out a bid.
